name: Madhuri Panda/ମାଧୁରୀ ପଣ୍ଡା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Madhuri Panda’s Odia poems in Kabita Live give separation a landscape of its own. In ‘ବିରହ ଭୋଗ’, an open window, the last star and a remembered hand carry the tension between absence and continued companionship. The poem moves between the demands of ordinary life and an inward journey towards the beloved.

In ‘ଗାଢ ଅନ୍ଧାର’, that journey becomes more uncertain. A forest without a visible path and letters that return unanswered give shape to the difficulty of reaching another person. Across these two poems, darkness and silence are active presences: they surround the speaker’s continuing search for connection.
